{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "relational",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the practiced wish in front of the whole assembly, blurring the wording so as not to name the wound aloud, and the presiding Dohkar is about to call for the cost to be spoken before the miracle",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_actor_id": "named:seren",
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice falters mid-invocation, her hands trembling as she shifts the offering from her earliest memory to Lirael’s unspoken wound, the crowd’s murmurs rising like a tide",
    "rising_beats": [
      "The presiding Dohkar’s gaze snaps to Seren, his fingers tightening around the ceremonial sash—his first sign of noticing the misalignment",
      "Julian steps forward, his posture unreadable, but his eyes lock onto Lirael’s muffled cry behind the cloth"
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Should she rip the cloth from her mouth and name the cost herself, or let Seren’s blurred wish stand as the truth?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_element_ids": ["O1", "O4", "O5"],
    "environment_realizations": {
      "O1": "the weeping-willow veil-canopy sways unevenly, some branches heavier with dew than others",
      "O4": "the gossamer band across Lirael’s mouth is frayed at the edges from repeated tying and untying",
      "O5": "the ornamented sash glints faintly in the dawn light, its embroidery slightly askew from the last hasty adjustment"
    },
    "interlocutor_placement": "the presiding Dohkar — the senior officiant who has performed this rite many times, his hands resting on the ceremonial sash he adjusts only when he is about to correct something",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "opening — she straightens her sash with deliberate slowness, the embroidered thread catching on her fingers, her breath shallow behind the cloth",
    "scene_want": "wants Julian to see her struggle without having to ask for his help",
    "scene_mission": "halt Seren’s misaligned wish before the presiding Dohkar calls for the cost to be spoken",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is abandoning the practiced wish, the presiding Dohkar is about to intervene, and Lirael’s mouth is muffled by a ceremonial cloth",
      "believes": "the rite is about to twist into something dangerous, and the cost of stopping it may be worse than the wish itself",
      "wondering": "why Julian is here and what he knows about the misalignment",
      "must_not_confuse": "who is physically present, what the ceremonial cloth does and does not do, and why Seren’s change matters"
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "opening — stress_tic (the frayed edges of the cloth)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2 — focus_tell (the way his gaze lingers on her muffled cry, as if he is waiting for her to speak)",
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_OPENING_BEAT" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ]
  },
  "scene_skeleton": {
    "character_plus": [
      {
        "character": "Seren",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-4",
        "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "Seren’s hands tremble as she shifts the offering from her earliest memory to Lirael’s unspoken wound, her voice faltering mid-invocation",
        "enacts_evidence_id": "E4",
        "behavior_object_ids": [],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "Her avoidance of naming the wound plainly reveals her belief that softening it is kinder than making it endure direct recognition, even in a moment of sacrifice.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "INWARD_TRANSLATION_OF_ANOTHER_PERSONS_COST",
        "pc_interpretation": "Seren believes she is protecting Lirael by not naming the wound, but her hesitation is making the cost worse for everyone."
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-8",
        "expression_mode": "CONTROL",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "The presiding Dohkar’s fingers tighten around his ceremonial sash, his gaze snapping to Seren as she falters, before he speaks the next line of the rite.",
        "enacts_evidence_id": "E6",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": ["named:seren"],
        "revelation_bridge": "His controlled reaction to the misalignment reveals his assumption that his judgment carries authority others have not earned, especially in questions of sacrifice.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "PERSONALIZE_SOCIAL_HARM",
        "pc_interpretation": "He sees this as a failure of precision, not a failure of heart, and his correction will make it worse for Seren."
      }
    ],
    "environment_plus": {
      "target_object_id": "O4",
      "axis": "damage",
      "beat": "the frayed edges of the cloth catch on her fingers as she adjusts it, the threads snagging like a warning"
    },
    "pc_opening_fusion": {
      "character": "Lirael",
      "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
      "character_angle": "her first embodied act reveals a woman who is both trained to read alignment and visibly unnerved by the weight of the moment",
      "beat": "she straightens her sash with deliberate slowness, the embroidered thread catching on her fingers, her breath shallow behind the cloth as Seren’s voice falters"
    }
  }
}
